name: FileFlows
description: FileFlows lets you process files through a visual rule-based flow system, with a primary focus on video file processing: converting to standard formats (HEVC/AC3), removing black bars, adding chapter points, and more. Supports a server plus additional processing nodes.

paths.name: Data Path
paths.description: Database and application data. Best kept on appdata.

paths.name: Temp Path
paths.description: Temporary files created during flow processing. Best placed on a cache/SSD drive.

paths.name: Media Path
paths.description: Mapping to the media/files you want FileFlows to process. Add as many of these as needed.

variables.name: PUID
variables.description: User ID the container runs as.

variables.name: PGID
variables.description: Group ID the container runs as.

variables.name: NVIDIA Visible Devices
variables.description: Set a specific GPU ID from FileFlows' settings page if you have multiple NVIDIA GPUs. Requires the NVIDIA container runtime.
